title: Israeli Air Strike on Gaza City Apartment Kills at Least Five
detail: An Israeli air strike on an apartment building in Gaza City killed at least five people. The death toll was confirmed by multiple outlets including Al Jazeera and Middle East Eye. The strike represents continued Israeli military operations in Gaza amid the ongoing ceasefire period.

media.caption: Israeli air strike kills at least five in Gaza City apartment building
Death toll from Israeli strike on Gaza apartment rises to five

title: Israeli Forces Launch Assassination Attempt Against Hamas's Newly Appointed Gaza Leader
detail: Israeli forces launched an assassination attempt against Hamas's newly appointed Gaza leader, according to The New Arab, marking a direct targeting of the post-Sinwar leadership structure. The strike represents Israel's continued effort to decapitate Hamas's command chain following the killing of Yahya Sinwar.

title: Funeral Held at Gaza Church for Mother and Daughter Killed in Israeli Strike
detail: A funeral was held at a church in Gaza for a mother and daughter killed in an Israeli strike, highlighting the ongoing civilian toll amid continued military operations. The ceremony underscores the impact on Gaza's Christian community and the broader civilian population facing repeated strikes despite the nominal ceasefire period.

media.caption: Funeral held at Gaza church for mother and daughter killed in Israeli strike
